questions.prompt: Do you prefer to travel alone or with a group? Why?
questions.sample_answer: I like to travel with friends rather than go alone because we can do many activities together, such as board games, team sports, etc. We can also have some beer and talk to each other.

questions.prompt: Tell me about an exciting summer vacation you went on.
questions.sample_answer:
The most exciting journey I have been on was when I visited Hanoi last week. That day, I visited Hoan Kiem Lake. I really like traveling because it allows me to explore new places, meet new people, and expand my knowledge. 

Or : Last month, I traveled to Da Lat City with my group of friends. We hired motorbikes to explore the city and enjoy the beautiful sights. We took a lot of gorgeous photos.

questions.prompt: Traveling a long distance by some means of transportation is not good for the environment. Do you agree?
questions.sample_answer: Traveling a long distance by some means of transportation is not good for the environment because transportation emits CO2 into the atmosphere, which causes environmental pollution.

metadata.scenario: Do you usually watch TV?

questions.title: TV Club - Part 2

questions.stem: Respond to the messages in the group.

questions.prompt: What do you like to do when you watch TV?
questions.sample_answer: When I watch TV, I usually sit on the sofa and have a drink. I like watching movies and sports programs. Sometimes, I eat some snacks while watching TV. I enjoy these activities because they help me relax after a busy day.

questions.prompt: Do you like watching TV alone or with others?
questions.sample_answer: I prefer watching TV with my family because we can enjoy the programs together. We can talk about interesting scenes and share our opinions. Moreover, watching TV together gives us more opportunities to spend quality time with each other.

questions.prompt: Is it good for children to watch TV programs too much?
questions.sample_answer: No, I don't think it is good for children to watch too much TV. It can hurt their eyes and reduce the time they spend playing outside. Children should also read books, exercise, and spend time with their family.

metadata.scenario: When and where do you like to walk?

questions.title: Walking club - Part 2

questions.stem: Respond to the messages in the group.

questions.prompt: I usually go for a walk. Do you like to walk or not?
questions.sample_answer: I love walking, and it’s part of my daily routine. I often walk to work, which is a great way to stay fit and clear my mind before starting the day.

questions.prompt: I like to walk, but when it rains, I get wet. Tell me about a time you had a bad experience while walking.
questions.sample_answer: Last year, I went on a long solo walk around Hoan Kiem Lake, which took almost two hours. When I got home, my legs were sore. While it was a memorable experience, I don’t think I’ll do it again unless I have a friend to join me.

questions.prompt: Walking is the best form of exercise. What do you think when many people walk and know if it is good for your health?
questions.sample_answer: I believe walking is the best form of exercise. Walking daily helps you stay fit and is an excellent way to relieve stress after a long day. It’s also completely free. It's accessible to everyone and doesn't require special equipment
